field.label: Log Level
field.help: Log verbosity. Use error or silent for long term operation.

field.label: Mode
field.help: rule: follow the routing rules. global: everything through the selected proxy. direct: no proxy.

field.label: Allow LAN
field.help: Let local clients use the proxy ports directly.

field.label: Bind Address
field.help: Controller listen address. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless you really need remote access.

field.label: TUN Mode
field.help: Route traffic into mihomo through a virtual device.

field.label: Device Name
field.help: Device name, must match the firewall rules (default tun_mihomo).

field.label: Automatic Route
field.help: Take over the default route. Without working proxy nodes this cuts the network off.

field.label: Strict Route
field.help: Keep the TUN device above other default routes.

field.label: DNS Module
field.help: Let mihomo resolve DNS itself (required for fake-ip).

field.label: Enhanced Mode
field.help: fake-ip returns synthetic addresses, redir-host returns real ones.

field.label: Subscription URL
field.help: Subscription URL, stored in the plugin environment file.

field.label: Access Secret
field.help: Secret written into the generated configuration.

field.label: Restart After Update
field.help: Restart the service after a successful update.
